name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 55V — SOT
description: Cluster of surface-mount SOT linear low-dropout voltage regulators rated for 55V with SOT-223-3_TabPin2 footprints.
selection_hints: Select when needing a 55V low-dropout linear regulator in an SMD SOT package.
Verify PCB design compatibility with the SOT-223-3_TabPin2 footprint.
Choose from tier A representative parts like MCP1792x-4102xDB or MCP1792x-5002xDB.
avoid_when: Do not use when surface-mount (SMD) packaging is not suitable.
Avoid if the design requires footprints other than SOT-223-3_TabPin2.
Avoid when a switching regulator or non-linear power topology is needed.
